articles.title: Severed Robot Hand Looks Like a Futuristic Thing From The Addams Family
articles.summary: Engineers at ETH Zurich trained a detached robot hand to balance on its fingers, crawl across many surfaces, type and play a puzzle game, which could one day help humanoid robots.

articles.title: Electronic Pioneer Suzanne Ciani Says "Now I Have an Audience"
articles.summary: The 80-year-old synthesizer pioneer, who created Coca-Cola's "pop & pour" sound, is playing her first Scotland show and a New Mexico desert festival, and says young people now share her machines.

articles.title: Stray Kids Join BTS in Withholding Music From Grammy Consideration
articles.summary: Stray Kids are reportedly skipping Grammy submissions, as BTS announced in July, after the Recording Academy added a best Asian pop music performance category it says will expand recognition.
